title: The Cutover
space: the student's own zone `{user}.dojo.test` and its repo; never the shared `dojo.test` zone
goal: `app.{user}.dojo.test` must point at the new server `10.20.0.{n}` and `www` must become an alias of `app`, in one commit, and the zone must show no other changes.
verify_text: the zone `{user}.dojo.test`: `app` is an A record at `10.20.0.{n}`, `www` is a CNAME to `app.{user}.dojo.test.` (and no longer an A record), the apex A and `mail` are unchanged. It can't see how many commits made the change.
hints: An alias is a CNAME; the target ends with a dot.
seed: `dojo-challenge start c2` creates `{user}/challenge-cutover` (cloned to `~/lab/challenge-cutover`): `app` and `www` are both A records at `10.10.0.5`; `n` is picked per student.
isolation: the student's own repo and their own zone; nobody else's zone is read or written.
answer: `dojo-challenge start c2`, `cd ~/lab/challenge-cutover`; change `A("app", "10.10.0.5")` to `A("app", "10.20.0.{n}")` and `A("www", ...)` to `CNAME("www", "app.{user}.dojo.test.")`; `dnscontrol preview`, one commit, `dnscontrol push`, then `dojo-check c2`.
